observations: Cold source-container selection exposes the full layer body through Advanced.
Deselect/reselect retains the full body without collapse/reopen repair.
Selecting the perennial container retargets layer and linked context, then shrub re-selection restores the shrub context.
Advanced expands and collapses; wheel scrolling reaches lower paint-set management, source properties and subsequent native pages.
Source properties expose width, length, active model list, following status and Edit layer.
Coverage opens in native Modify; Start Brush, pointer drag, Stop, Update and keyboard Undo are exercised separately.
scope: Real Max 2027, two native command-panel columns at 1920x1032. Narrow/wide layout dimensions are covered by the final isolated layout fixture, not a final pointer border resize.
limits: Not every control, DPI or docking arrangement. First cold Undo/Redo lost its stack; the controlled repeat passed and the unresolved observation is retained separately.
